name: Noroi o Toku Made
source:
A boy is standing in a forest.
His body is being consumed by a curse placed upon him.

The effects of the curse can only be delayed by regular sexual intercourse with demihumans,
so he made up his mind and stepped foot into a forest known to be home to many of them.

[Translated from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0068510/]Digiket[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩站在森林里。
他的身体正在被施加在他身上的诅咒所吞噬。

只有通过与亚人定期性交才能延迟诅咒的效果，
于是他下定决心，踏进了一片森林，那里栖息着许多动物。

[译自[url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0068510/]Digiket[/url]]
